prose: Ai2 released Olmo-core 3, an upgrade to its LLM training framework with a redesigned open mixture-of-experts system. It is designed to scale MoE training to the trillion-parameter range while keeping compute efficiency, and underpins the next generation of Olmo. It continues Ai2's habit of opening its training tools, aiming to put large-model development within reach of academics.
highlights: Olmo-core 3 with a redesigned open MoE training system.
